argument.reason: Without assuming G, named axioms and their two UI rounds produce only AZ/AS instances I (and the AS one-quantifier prefixes). Target is inserted in the formula basis, not as a zero-port fact.

An equality used as the first eq_subst input must have BOTH sides in P. An atom used as its second input must have one side in P and the other in P or S(P), because only identity/successor hole contexts and a P-valued other operand exist.
argument.step: When transport can use an atom

argument.reason: For u in P, u+0 lies in P only for u=0 or u=n. Every other u+0 has add at its root and lies in neither P nor S(P). Thus all other AZ instances can serve as neither transport input. The two usable instances lie inside Z.

For u,v in P, S(u+v) is never in P. The other side u+S(v) is in P only for u=n,v=S(0), when it is A. In that sole case the right side is S(B), outside P union S(P). Hence EVERY AS instance can serve as neither equality-input nor formula-input of transport. This rules out indirect AS-based detours too.

Every side of a Z equality is one of 0,n,0+0,n+0, so none begins with succ. Successor-context transport cannot use a Z atom as its second input. Identity-context transport using a Z equality merely replaces an endpoint by another term in the same class; its result remains in Z. Inert I atoms cannot enter a transport step. Thus I union Z is closed under every reachable equality transport.

Generalization adds forall n F only from an already reachable equality F. UI recipes were frozen before those generalized formulae were added. Their only n-bound antecedent that could bootstrap the target is G itself; the other UI antecedents are the original x-bound axioms and y-bound AS prefixes. Those supply only I. Since E is not in I union Z, G cannot be first reached via generalization; G-guarded target-instance licences cannot initiate that cycle.

Induct on strict-prior primitive commands, or equivalently use the propositional Horn countervaluation described below. All reachable atoms remain in I union Z, E is absent, and so G is absent at every finite stage. The argument does not depend on24 or20 seconds.
